purpose: Isolate the value of Swedish-born / foreign-born population state in the Profet-like migration engine before adding consistency adjustment.

state.note: Fertility and mortality remain identical to the production model in this stage so only the migration/state dimension changes.

migration.internationalIn: national immigration by birth status x municipal historical share within status x local age/sex profile within status

nationalFuture.populationExposure: SCB national projected mean population by birth region, aggregated to Swedish-born / foreign-born
nationalFuture.immigration: SCB national projected immigration by birth region, aggregated to Swedish-born / foreign-born

governance: No age-specific or birth-status-specific tuning after viewing rolling-origin results. If promising, lock new external municipalities before external evaluation.
